Features

What Trycord does

Every capability below ships in the product today. Where a feature is off by default, opt-in, or still in progress, the card says so.

Conversations

Talking, in the shape a community needs

Shipped

Communities and channels

Each community holds its own channels, and can group them into categories. Membership is per community, and a channel's permissions come from the community's roles.

Shipped

Direct messages and friends

One-to-one conversations outside any community, with a friends list and requests, so people you know do not need a shared community to talk.

Shipped

Reactions and attachments

Messages carry reactions and file attachments. Uploads are size-limited per instance, and the limit is a setting rather than a constant in the code.

Shipped

Search

Messages are searchable across the communities you can already see. Search respects permissions, so it never surfaces a channel you cannot open.

Shipped

Presence and typing

Who is online, idle or away, and who is typing, over the realtime gateway. Presence is per instance and never leaves it.

Shipped

Notifications

In-app notifications for mentions and replies, with per-conversation mutes when a channel is too busy to follow.

Running a community

Tools for the people who keep it civil

Shipped

Roles and permissions

Roles carry granular permissions and are assigned per member. A misspelled permission is a startup error, not a silent grant or refusal.

Shipped

Invites

Codes that can expire and be limited in use, so you can open a door for a while without leaving it open permanently.

Shipped

Reports and moderation

Members report messages and people. Moderators review, warn, time out or ban, and every action is recorded against the account that took it.

Shipped

Appeals

A suspended account has a path to appeal, and the appeal is a record the platform administrators can see and act on.

Shipped

Announcements

Instance-wide announcements for maintenance and policy, so operators do not have to rely on a side chat nobody reads.

Shipped

Platform administration

A separate Trust and Safety surface for reports that cross communities, plus a configuration centre where every setting has an effect.

Accounts and safety

Getting in, and getting out

Shipped

Registration and approval

Registration can be open, require manual approval by an admin, or be closed entirely. Users can be invited by code instead.

Shipped

Two-factor authentication

Time-based codes with recovery codes, available per account and enforced by the account, not by the instance.

Shipped

Email verification and recovery

Verification and password reset deliver through SMTP or an HTTPS mail API. With mail unconfigured, recovery refuses rather than pretending to send.

Shipped

Your data, exportable

An account can export its data and delete itself, with a cooling-off window. Deletion is a real deletion, not a flag.

The instance

What an operator controls

Shipped

Public discovery

Communities can publish themselves to a public directory with a preview of their channels. Private communities never appear in it, and the whole feature can be switched off.

Shipped

Bots and integrations

A bot API and per-community integrations with webhooks, so a community can connect things without a human relaying messages.

Shipped

Themes

A default dark and light theme, plus custom themes that write the same design tokens the stylesheet defines, so a theme cannot invent values the app does not have.

Shipped

SQLite or MySQL

Start on a single SQLite file and move to MySQL when you outgrow it. The database is a configuration profile, not a different build.

Still in progress

What is still being built, and what is opt-in

A few parts of the product are deliberately incomplete. Here they are, with the state each one is actually in.

Voice and video In progress

The signalling and room model are in place behind a single provider. It is off by default, ships with one provider, and is not a finished calling product.

Push notifications to devices In progress

The switch and supporting code exist, and both default to off. In-app notifications work today; delivery to a sleeping phone does not yet.

Cross-instance federation Planned

Each instance stands alone today. There is a global sync setting and early groundwork for it, but separate instances do not yet federate.
